title: Send regular stakeholder updates
summary: Short, regular updates keep stakeholders informed and save meetings. Tell them what changed, what is next and what you need.

beginner: Agree who gets updates and how often, for example every two weeks.
Use the same short format each time: what we did, what we learned, what is next, what we need.
Include one number that shows progress towards the outcome.
Flag risks early, with what you are doing about them.
Keep it short enough to read in two minutes.
experienced: Use updates to shape opinion before big decisions.
Make updates self-service with live dashboards.

toolExamples.confluence: Use a blog post or page per update so there is a history.
toolExamples.notion: Keep an update template and archive.
toolExamples.claude: Paste your notes and ask for a two-minute update in your template, then edit it.
